description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git functionalities, particularly related to commit graph features including Bloom filters, commit graph writing, validation, and corruption handling. It contains setup procedures, test cases, and validation checks to ensure correct behavior of Git's commit graph implementation.

methods.name: graph_read_expect
methods.description: Reads a graph and validates its header and chunks, checking against expected values.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes a test repository, commits files, sets up commit graph options, and prepares for bloom filter tests.

methods.name: test_bloom_filters_used
methods.description: Validates that bloom filters are being used during log commands with specified options.

methods.name: test_bloom_filters_not_used
methods.description: Ensures bloom filters are not used during certain log commands.

methods.name: test_max_changed_paths
methods.description: Validates the 'max_changed_paths' value in trace output.

methods.name: test_filter_not_computed
methods.description: Checks that the change-path filter was not computed for a given trace.

methods.name: test_filter_computed
methods.description: Checks that the change-path filter was computed for a given trace.

methods.name: test_filter_trunc_empty
methods.description: Checks that the 'filter-trunc-empty' trace key has expected value.

methods.name: test_filter_trunc_large
methods.description: Checks that the 'filter-trunc-large' trace key has expected value.

methods.name: test_filter_upgraded
methods.description: Checks that the change-path filter was upgraded.

methods.name: corrupt_graph
methods.description: Simulates corruption of the commit graph files for testing error handling.

methods.name: check_corrupt_graph
methods.description: Runs corruption on the graph and verifies that Git handles it correctly.

methods.name: get_first_changed_path_filter
methods.description: Reads the first change-path filter from the commit graph.
